test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

__He conceded__(a__)__ / __a very crucial__ (b)/ __point at__ (c)/ __his opponent __(d__)__.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'point at'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'point to' **should be used instead of **'point at'.**
 
• The preposition 'to' is used to show a person or thing that receives something.
 
 
• Example: I am grateful **to** my parents.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, the receiver of the action is the 'opponent'.
 
• The use of 'at' is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The preposition ‘**at**’ must be replaced with ‘**to**’. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He conceded a very crucial **point to** his opponent.*
